dossier.researchSummary: Primary-source inspection of the Hugging Face repository microsoft/Phi-4-mini-reasoning confirms a model card page and repository blobs including config.json, tokenizer files, merges.txt, LICENSE, and two safetensors shards. The repository commit history contains commits such as 661e722... and 7196d37... but does not contain the exact SHA 511de4e658 (Evidence gap). Config blobs identify the model class as Phi3ForCausalLM (model_type 'phi3') with 32 layers, hidden_size 3072, 24 attention heads, vocab_size 200064, and max_position_embeddings 131072; tokenizer_config and tokenizer.json indicate GPT2Tokenizer usage, chat template, and special token IDs. No numeric benchmark tables tied explicitly to this exact checkpoint were found in the model card or linked repository blobs (Evidence gap). License file in the repo is MIT. Key primary-file locators used are listed in sources.
